_doc: The auto fixer's cause catalogue (machine-read by scripts/auto-fixer/prep.mjs). signature: a case-insensitive regex over an attempt's reason. status: fixed (verified live) | fixed-unverified (code + test, last step not seen live) | watching | not-fixable. fixedAt: ms of the fix commit; a failure matching a fixed cause from a build made after fixedAt is a regression.
